fn_diff: 1167 KV and attention functions matched by name, 1154 identical, 13 changed. The 13 are the three `v_head_fn` closures of the FPGA staging path (+10 instructions each: the alignment assert of `v_destination_row`) and ten `page` methods that copy tokens (+2 to +22 instructions: the `pair_base` assert, two per copied token). Among the row-path functions (`save_v_impl` of every model), 102 of 484 matched functions change by -37 to +40 instructions: the two asserts plus the compiler's re-scheduling around them. Whole binary: 224038 instructions before, 224208 after, in the matched set (exec/results/i4557runar-20261007/fn-diff.txt).
